def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    principal = 150_000
    index_rate = 0.02
    margin = 0.015
    remaining_months = 10 * 12

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    annual_rate = index_rate + margin
    monthly_rate = annual_rate / 12
    payment = principal * monthly_rate * (1 + monthly_rate) ** remaining_months / (
        (1 + monthly_rate) ** remaining_months - 1
    )

    # Return the answer rounded to the nearest cent
    return round(payment, 2)
